## What changes

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Separate implemented changes from research proposals.

## Why

Explain the reasoning, model assumptions, and relevant source or issue.

## Validation

List the commands and results that support this change. For physics changes, include the calibration/validation split, seed and configuration, and affected observables.

## Compatibility and limits

Describe replay compatibility, whether the physics build changes, known limitations, and any updated documentation or public downloads.
